_comment: Build-time origins registry (D-14) for the STABLE channel (D-19) — the public default. Consumed by tools/build_catalog.py (EPIC-10) to produce the consolidated atari-st/apps.json. Sibling channels: origins/atari-st-test.json, origins/atari-st-dev.json. Exactly one origin is official. To add an unofficial creator, copy the template under "_example_unofficial_origin" below into "origins".

_example_unofficial_origin._comment: INERT TEMPLATE — kept as documentation, not a live origin. build_catalog.py only reads the "origins" array, so nothing under this key is fetched or published; the schema allows it (additionalProperties: true). To onboard a real creator, copy the object below into "origins" (dropping this "_comment"), set official=false, and point "url" at their apps.json — HTTP or HTTPS, fetched server-side at build time, HTTPS recommended (D-16). Prefer a remote "url" over an in-repo "source": "source" is for the official origin, and using it for a creator means the store, not the creator, owns their listing. Then rerun tools/build_catalog.py. See CREATORS.md.
